units.source_text: 文艺春秋社的斋藤龙太郎在附近的旅馆里疗养，我们在归途中顺道去探视了他。

en.t: Saito Ryutaro of Bungei Shunju was recuperating at a nearby inn, so on our way back we stopped by to visit him.

units.source_text: 斋藤告诉我们，前些天他才刚从吴清源的邻室搬走。

en.t: Saito told us that only a few days earlier he had just moved out of the room next to Go Seigen's.
